llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Pruna video-animation API guide that uploads user-provided media to Pruna for the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: External network use and PRUNA_API_KEY use are expected for a Pruna API model skill and are shown directly in the HTTP examples; no unrelated local file access or broad environment scanning is present.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It recommends installing related Pruna skills with npx skills add, including an optional full-suite install; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should understand it changes the skill environment.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to confirm credentials, collect explicit video and image inputs, run prompt-preparation steps, and confirm generation settings before the paid API call.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions only, no executable scripts, no background worker, no persistence mechanism, and no privilege escalation behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is animating a still image using motion from a source video, and the instructions, required inputs, Pruna model name, and curl examples all align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the selected image, source video, prompts, and API key-authenticated requests to Pruna. Review the optional related-skill installs before accepting them, and avoid using private or sensitive media unless Pruna is an appropriate processor for that content.
llm.findings: [E1] expected: The flagged api.pruna.ai URLs are the disclosed service endpoint used to upload the user-selected video and image and create Pruna predictions, which is necessary for this API-integration skill rather than evidence of hidden exfiltration.
